## T4  rank-one pole reduction.  POLE = +2 C(f)^2 on even f (C = int f cosh(x/2)), -2 S(f)^2 on odd f (S = int f sinh(x/2)).
rho_sec(c) = 2 <p, (K - cQ)^{-1} p> with K = ARCH - CONST, p = cosh(x/2) (even) or sinh(x/2) (odd).
Exact criterion: odd sector PSD  <=>  K - cQ > 0 on odd and rho_odd(c) <= 1;
even sector PSD  <=>  K - cQ has exactly one negative eigenvalue on even and rho_even(c) <= -1.
